text:
maria_garcia: Heads-up — onboarding Tessera9B (vendor snapshot). Intake notes: new 9B decoder-only, we plan PTQ 4-bit + K/V cache. Can we prioritize bring-up? Early post-launch smoke shows two issues: intermittent short hallucinations with deterministic sampling, and a latency spike for prompts >1024 tokens.

devon_ng: repro'd the hallucination locally on q4 bench. Happens when prompt contains a numeric list. Short example leads to '…and the capital is Zor' which is wrong. Will share minimal repro.

devon_ng: ```bash
# repro (local q4)
python bench_infer.py --model tessera9b-q4 --prompt "List the top 5 planets by size" --seed 123 --max-tokens 40
```

sophie_klein: Interesting — might be quant-induced logits skew for low-frequency tokens. Check layernorm fp32 fallback and softmax accumulation precision. Also verify fused-attn path fallback for long sequences.

alex_chang: TL;DR on latency: on canary we see 600ms/token after 1k tokens vs 50ms/token baseline early. GPU profiler shows occasional kernel retries + memory copies. Could be KV cache growth + cache eviction threshold.

ops_jay: Deploy notes: canary is on Dedicated pool g4dn-equivalent. We can roll back traffic to tessera9b-fp16 variant if needed. Current canary @ 2% traffic. Want to pause?

maria_garcia: Not yet — need triage. Priority: P1 for hallucination regression on deterministic samplers affecting evals, P2 for tail latency.

devon_ng: Quick debug: toggling `--kv-cache-evict-threshold=0.8` reduces tail latency in synthetic load. Need to confirm with real prompts.

sophie_klein: Add these checklist items for bring-up and post-launch triage:
- verify tokenizer parity vs vendor snapshot (bytepair merges)
- run eval set with deterministic sampling + temperature=0 to catch halluc types
- compare logits distributions between fp16 and q4 on small batch of eval prompts
- check layernorm/order of ops for fused kernels
- run long prompt stress test (1k-8k tokens) to profile KV cache memory churn
- run ngram-repeat/regression suite from eval-bot

eval-bot: Benchmarks posted -> https://ci.redwood/internal/reports/tessera9b/q4/smoke-2026-03-20 (summary: perplexity delta +2.1 vs fp16 on deterministic set; top-k entropy shift on rare tokens)

alex_chang: Also confirm driver/cuda/cudnn versions pinned. We had a similar kernel fallback last quarter when drivers mismatched.

ops_jay: I'll snapshot canary logs and increase sampling rate for the failing prompt bucket. If spikes continue we'll flip the canary to 0% and route to fp16.

maria_garcia: Action items:
- devon: produce minimal repro and attach model artifact + quant config (due EOD) :eyes:
- sophie: run fp16 vs q4 logits diff on flagged eval prompts, include per-layer stats (tomorrow morning)
- alex: audit infra drivers and GPU schedules; see if kernel retry patterns match other models
- ops_jay: save canary logs and prepare rollback script, hold at 2% until we confirm
- eval-bot: add deterministic-halluc test to nightly and notify when delta > 1.0 perplexity

maria_garcia: If anyone finds a quick mitigation (e.g., softmax accumulation fp32 patch or kv-evict tweak) post here and we'll apply to canary. :thumbsup:

devon_ng: Will upload repro bundle in this thread — including `.onnx` q4 export and sampling script.

sophie_klein: Also note: vendor released small patch for fused-attn ordering yesterday. Might be relevant. I'll try applying locally. :bug:

maria_garcia: Thanks — let's regroup after the repro + logs. Will schedule 30m triage call if needed.
